evidence.title: SC Zeus Launches Flagship Data Center in Osaka
evidence.excerpt: SC Zeus reports breaking ground on ZEUS OSA 1 in Nanko, Osaka, and explicitly reports 70 MW of IT load over two phases backed by a secured 100 MW utility allocation.
